summary: Mandatory architectural drawing sanction before commencing construction or structural alteration of residential houses.
estimated_total_cost: ₹15 – ₹30 per square yard scrutiny fee + labor cess

steps.title: Engage registered architect
steps.description: Architect prepares computer-aided CAD drawings conforming to FAR, setbacks, height, and parking bylaws.

steps.title: Submit via Online Building Plan Approval System (OBPAS)
steps.description: Upload CAD drawings; automated system runs algorithmic rule-checking against city master plan bylaws.

steps.title: Multi-department scrutiny
steps.description: Fire department, public health engineering, and structural division review clearances simultaneously.

steps.title: Pay building permit fee & labor cess
steps.description: Remit approved sanction fees, external development charges, and 1% building workers welfare cess.

steps.title: Download sanctioned building permit
steps.description: Download digitally stamped Naksha blueprint with QR verification code valid for 3 years.
